trades.name: Rejection/LAAF of 6496-6502.5
trades.quote: Short a rejection or LAAF of 6496-6502.5. This could end up being a sweep and fail of Friday’s afternoon rally high (ARH) which was 6493 and not included in the levels due to proximity to 6496-6502.5. If not for the weekly level, I would have used 91-93 and specifically looked for a LAAF. This broadly targets 6478, 6466, and 6460 with runners if sellers find continuation through Friday’s low (as a weak market would do). As unenthused as I was for the weekly plan, this is actually an A/A+ setup. Risk would be very well-defined with 30 handles as very reasonable to expect.

trades.name: Longs in 6459-6461 protecting Friday's low
trades.quote: Because of the above fact (backside excess) I may look for longs in the 6459-6461 range (6460 has been so important anyway) if buyers are able to protect Friday’s low from this spot. With this type of trade one needs to monitor for a reaction before executing and risk is a bit harder to define with a stop relative to a LBAF/LAAF trade. I also have less confidence in upside targets (6478 and 6491-93 with runners if 6496-6502.5 clears) so I’ll rate this one a B.
trades.stop_hint: if buyers are able to protect Friday’s low from this spot

trades.name: Higher low above 6496-6502.5
trades.quote: One can attempt longs on a higher low above 6496-6502.5 (technically 6493 based on Friday’s profile) but this is risky because of the potential for a LAAF. Sellers can step in anywhere in the B-period singles (6513-6415 and 6520-6524 perhaps the most likely) so it requires a tight leash. I’m not a huge fan of reclaim longs so I rate this a C+/B-.

trades.name: Reactive short in 6520-6524
trades.quote: I will consider a short above 6496-6502.5, particularly in the 6520-6524 range, if sellers make their presence clear and produce some kind of structure break. If you’ve been int he Discord long enough to know some of the more advanced snipe trades it would likely be something of that nature. This has to be fully reactive so I can’t really bother rating it.
